@Override
public void visitAttribute(@NonNull XmlContext context, @NonNull Attr attr) {
    if (!ANDROID_MANIFEST_XML.equals(context.file.getName())) {
        return;
    }
    String value = attr.getValue();
    if (value.isEmpty() || !value.startsWith(PREFIX_RESOURCE_REF)) {
        return;

    ResourceUrl url = ResourceUrl.parse(value);
    if (url == null || url.isCreate() || url.theme) {
        return;

    ResourceType type = url.type;
    if (type == null) {
        return;
    }
    if (isApplicationTitleOrIcon(attr)) {
        return;
    }
    if (url.packageName != null && !url.packageName.equals(context.getMainProject().getPackage())) {
        return;
    }
    Set<Variant> variants = getVariants(type, url.name);
    if (variants == null || variants.isEmpty()) {
        return;
    }
    if (hasOnlyVersionVariation(variants)) {
        return;
    }
    String message = String.format(
        "The %1$s attribute must not reference a resource that varies across configurations (except by version); `%2$s` has variations: %3$s",
        attr.getName(), value, describe(variants)
    );
    context.report(ISSUE, attr, context.getValueLocation(attr), message);
}
